structured_output.what_is_happening: BREW is a 26-minute-old token with a pool created directly on PumpSwap. It did not graduate from the pump.fun curve; deploy platform is unknown and the pool was created 4 seconds after the mint. Market cap is about $31.6k with liquidity of about $36k, so liquidity is larger than market cap. Volume jumped to $51k in 5 minutes on a +183% move. GeckoTerminal counts 2,061 unique buyers against only 55 sellers in 30 minutes, with an average buy of about $36. In the latest 5 minutes, activity fell to about 20 buyers and 14 sellers, and price is flat against the peak. One unlabeled wallet holds 27.69%. LP is 100% unlocked and the creator has closed out. At least 9 other 'BREW' tokens launched in the past few hours. Several now have zero liquidity, including EEwu…, which did $53k of volume in the last hour and now has $0 liquidity. That points to a batch of copycat launches that are being rugged.

narrative.description: A generic 'BREW' ticker with no website, socials or description, apart from a GeckoTerminal X handle 'brewdotfamily' that isn't verified. Many same-name tokens launched in the same few hours, which looks like a copycat or rug-farm wave around some BREW theme rather than one clear story.
narrative.why_spreading: The attention probably comes from ticker-sniping bots and many tiny wallets buying whatever BREW contract shows up, not from a coherent story. The 2,061 buyers vs 55 sellers pattern looks farmed.

token_connection.why_this_token: Nothing marks this contract as the real BREW. It is one of about 10 recent BREW launches, and its liquidity is still intact while several copies have already dropped to zero.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Many BREW contracts: 3897… and 96oP… show $13-22M 'liquidity' with zero volume (probably fake or illiquid). Recent copies D7UU…, 4w2N…, EEwu…, mgWm… and 97hh… all have $0 liquidity, which suggests they were rugged. Homebrew Robotics tokens also use BREW.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer/seller split is extremely lopsided (2,061 unique buyers vs 55 sellers) with small, even-sized buys, which fits holder-count farming or many bot wallets. Liquidity is larger than market cap on a pool that was not made through the pump.fun curve. One 27.7% wallet is unlabeled, and GeckoTerminal puts top-10 holders at 99.65%. Same-name copies are rugging in sequence. GMGN shows 4 bundlers and 0 smart or renowned wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN's bot/degen rate reads 0, and there are no insider flags. Some of the buyers could be real retail chasing the BREW theme.
